note: Family tally: table-grid 22, line 6, flowchart-or-schematic 3, bar 1, other 1. Coverage: 22 table rows + 10 figure rows + 24 refusals = 56 measured regions over 23 of the 33 pages. Declared rather than repaired: Figure 7.6 is a radar pentagon and the family vocabulary has no radar member, so it is filed as other instead of being forced into line or surface-or-3D; Table 7.1's caption is the one caption the text layer cannot be quoted from, because the page prints it on the same line as the tail of formula 3, so that verbatim is typed from the crop and marked typed-from-crop; Table 3.1 prints only four of the ten coaches its own prose promises, with an ellipsis row standing where the other six would be, and the row count records what the page prints. rules: Every caption in this paper prints BELOW its exhibit, without exception - the twenty-two numbered grids, the six charts, the three diagrams and the two symbolic norm drawings all put the number under the object, which is the exact opposite of the lane's other 2014 paper [caption.position]

Five of the numbered grids have their caption on a different page from the fragment that carries their header - Table 5.2, 6.2, 6.4, 6.7 and 7.2 all break between the last data row and the caption - so the row is the TOPMOST fragment (the one holding the header) and the caption is quoted from the page that prints it [caption.position]

The four unnumbered notation grids carry no number and no caption of any kind; each is introduced by a bold bullet ('Symbols for AHP:', etc.) printed above its top rule, and one of the four is itself split across pages 4 and 5 [caption.numbering]

The house style is a full frame - outer box, a rule between every row and a vertical between every column - and exactly three grids depart from it: Table 4.3 and Table 6.1 and Table 6.2 print horizontals only, with no column verticals at all [table.rule_style]

Two grids are two tables printed inside one frame: Table 4.2 and Table 6.1 repeat their header and drop a vertical divider down the middle, so six printed columns carry ten ranks in five body rows [table.merged_cells]

Only Table 4.1 and Table 6.7 merge cells, and both merge vertically: Table 4.1's Goal cell spans all fourteen body rows and Table 6.7's aspect stubs span their metric rows. A wrapped header or a two-line turning-point cell is one cell, not a merge, and neither is counted [table.merged_cells]

Shading is used three different ways and only two are zebra: the comparison grids 6.4-6.6 band alternate rows 238/255 while marking movers in BOLD rather than with fill, Table 4.3 bands in two-row pairs, Tables 6.3 and 6.8 shade a fixed set of rows with no key at all, and Tables 3.1/3.2/4.1/4.2/5.2/6.7/7.2 shade only their header [table.zebra]

The paper points at most of its exhibits without a number - 'the following table shows', 'shown in following table', 'Here are our results:', 'The following figure shows', '(See figure)' - so twenty-five of the twenty-six numbered exhibits have mention count zero and only Figure 7.1 is cited by number, once, on its own page [mention.count]

The charts are all Excel or PowerPoint exports flattened into bitmaps, and they carry no data labels anywhere: the reader gets ticks and a legend and must read values off the mark. Two of them have no legend at all and identify their parameter through an in-art title or a callout [geometry.data_labels]

The six charts print an in-art title that is a SECOND title, different from the caption, and in Figure 7.1 the two disagree about what the x axis is ('evaluation factors' vs 'the weight of each factor for each aspect') [geometry.family]

Two exhibits have no number and no caption: the four notation grids, and the three-sport photo block that closes section IX. The block prints five ranks of coach portraits with a header row above the measured region and no title under it at all [caption.verbatim]

The photo block is the only exhibit in the paper built out of rasters rather than one picture: fifteen separate portrait images, three per sport per rank, each its own measured region. The block is counted once and the fifteen are refused as fragments [geometry.panel_count]
Nothing in the paper is landscape, nothing is three-dimensional, nothing has a colour bar, and no chart shares an axis with another [table.orientation]
